name: [[786,8,27]] eightfold local reduction of planar tile code

provenance.construction: Eight local reductions from codes/794-8-27.json: delete X row 339 and qubit 338; in the 793-qubit code XOR Z rows 372 and 373 to get support [338,357,358,753,774], use Z row 373 as pivot, clear qubit 774 and delete the pivot and qubit; in the 792-qubit code delete sole X row 142 and qubit 119; in the 791-qubit code use Z row 0 with support [0,432] as pivot, clear qubit 0 and delete the pivot and qubit; in the 790-qubit code use Z row 40 with support [77,430] as pivot, clear qubit 430 and delete the pivot and qubit; in the 789-qubit code use Z row 370 with support [355,770] as pivot, clear qubit 770 and delete the pivot and qubit; in the 788-qubit code use Z row 12 with support [11,12,31,49,404,423,442,443] as pivot, clear qubit 404 and delete the pivot and qubit; in the 787-qubit code use Z row 15 with support [15, 16, 35, 53, 407, 426, 445, 446] as pivot, clear qubit 407 from other Z checks and delete the pivot and qubit. At each step delete the corresponding coordinate, shorten opposite-side checks, and preserve remaining order.
provenance.notes: Eight local row reductions lower n from 794 to 786 while preserving k=8, weight 8, one-layer radius 4, and explicit X-27 and Z-27 logicals. Distance is a witness upper bound.
